messages:
anya (PM): Heads-up — need to finalize the model capability flags + discovery endpoint for next quarter. Customer asks keep coming: streaming + function/tool discovery + explicit token limits. Who can take the spec?

sam (eng): I can take lead on the API shape. My rough proposal: a single discovery endpoint GET /v1/models/:id/capabilities that returns a capability object. Candidate fields: supports_streaming (bool), streaming_formats (list), function_calling (enum), max_context_tokens (int), max_input_tokens (int), max_output_tokens (int), tools (list of {name, schema_url, version, required_params}), structured_output: {schema_url, strictness_hint}.

leila (ML): +1. Also add embedding_dim for embedding models, quantization_hint (e.g., "int8", "fp16"), and a simple latency_estimates array keyed by seq_len buckets (e.g., "<=128", "129-1024"): this helps product-level routing.

mike (DevEx): Important UX items: human-friendly feature names, a short description per flag, and a compatibility hint for hosted/dedicated/private. Also include recommended_batch_size and default_cache_ttl for ops.

sam (eng): Also include streaming_formats: ["text", "json_lines", "delta_json"] and function_calling: ["none","optional","required"]. For tools we should include input_validation (bool) and example_invocation snippets.

anya (PM): Launch criteria proposal: discovery endpoint implemented + stable schema version, SDKs mapping all flags, docs + examples, canary with 3-5 customers, and regression tests for schema changes. Priority: streaming + structured output + function discovery for initial launch.

leila (ML): For tool/function support add flags: supports_tools (bool), tools[].schema (JSON Schema URL), tools[].sandboxed (bool), tool_token_cost_hint (int) for arg accounting. We need to be explicit about token accounting for tool args vs model tokens.

sam (eng): Negotiation note: MVP scope = chat/completions capability flags, streaming formats, function discovery schema, basic token limits, and schema versioning. Post-MVP we add rerank meta (score normalization, supports_batch_rerank), embeddings metadata (vector_dim, normalized_scores), and per-model quantization profiles.

mike (DevEx): SDK impact: include capabilities_schema_version string and a small examples array in the response with 1-2 sample payloads per mode. That avoids ambiguous mapping for client libs. Also expose a "deprecation_notice" field when flipping flags.

deploy-bot: created spec doc at https://redwood.internal/specs/capflags-1758603011 — reviewers: @sam, @leila, @mike. CI: schema lint + example roundtrips.

anya (PM): Assignments: @sam — OpenAPI patch + example responses, @leila — ML fields and latency buckets, @mike — docs + SDK mappings, I'll coordinate customer canaries and launch criteria. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam (eng): I'll drop a minimal JSON sample in the spec now for visibility. Example snippet:
```json
{
  "model_id": "redwood-large-v1",
  "capabilities_schema_version": "2026-03-01",
  "supports_streaming": true,
  "streaming_formats": ["text","json_lines"],
  "function_calling": "optional",
  "max_context_tokens": 32768,
  "max_input_tokens": 30000,
  "max_output_tokens": 1024,
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "calendar",
      "schema_url": "https://redwood.internal/schemas/tools/calendar-v1.json",
      "version": "1.0",
      "required_params": ["start_time","end_time"],
      "input_validation": true
    }
  ]
}
```

leila (ML): Nice. One more: include "latency_estimates": [{"seq_len":"<=128","p50_ms":"120","p95_ms":"420"}] so product can set SLO hints.

anya (PM): Great — if no blockers, we'll target a spec review next Tue and a small canary by end of the sprint. Keep comments inline on the spec doc.
